title: Document
description: The Rosetta AST produced by the parser. Node is deliberately one flat shape discriminated by `type`, so that it maps cleanly to both TypeScript and Go.

rosettaVersion.description: Spec version the document was parsed as, for example 0.1.

frontMatter.description: Preserved YAML front matter, if any.

frontMatterRaw.description: The front matter text between the --- lines, exactly as written, so tools can save it back unchanged. Present even when it is not valid YAML (then frontMatter is absent).

tight.description: list: true when its items are not separated by blank lines (items render without paragraphs).

header.description: tableRow, true for the header row.

kind.description: directive: unknown when no component definition was found.

attributesRaw.description: directive: the text between the braces exactly as written (absent when there were no braces), so it can be saved back unchanged, with shorthands, quotes and mistakes as they were. A tool that changes the attributes must drop it.

fields.description: directive, data components: parsed YAML-style fields.

raw.description: directive: the raw body text. Always present for unknown components; for data components it is the body as written, kept next to the parsed fields so it can be saved back unchanged. A tool that changes a data component's fields must drop it.
